sentences.text:
2. At the instance of the opposite party No.2, the F.I.R. dated 13.10.2021 in Dhenkanal Town P.S.
Case No.429 of 2021 for the alleged commission of offence punishable under Section 420 of the I.P.C. came to be registered against the petitioner.

The petitioner is the father-in-law of the opposite party No.2.
3.
After investigation, charge-sheet in the present case has been filed on 11.04.2022.
Subsequent thereto, on 18.04.2022, the learned S.D.J.M., Dhenkanal has taken cognizance of the offence punishable under Section 420 of I.P.C. against the petitioner.
4. Mr. Rajgarhia, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that there are many dispute inter-se parties pending which are essentially arising out of a matrimonial discord.
5. Issue notice to the opposite parties.
Mr. Mohanty, learned Additional Standing Counsel appears on behalf of the State- opposite party No.1 and waives the notice.
Let one extra copy of the brief be served on him within three working days.
6. Notice be issued to the opposite party No.2 by Speed Post/Registered Post with A.D., fixing short returnable date.
Requisites shall be filed within three working days.

7. Notice on opposite party No.2 be also served through the I.I.C., Dhenkanal Town P.S.
8.
List this matter after four weeks.
